limits.comment: Synthetic visuals: procedural motion graphics rendered from code. Generated media: AI-generated voice (Kokoro-82M v1.0, voice af_heart, run locally), labeled on screen; not a person. Motion graphics rendered from code by this video's stage; example data on screen is synthetic. The music bed is procedural synthesis written for this video, with no samples or third-party audio. Narration is an AI-generated voice (Kokoro-82M v1.0, voice af_heart), labeled on screen. Interface shots are real captures: the live public pages of eranos.ta-amps.workers.dev and the Agora overview, and a local Eranos and Tessera run with scripted agents and synthetic data. The reveal board shows what the local production Tessera store held when the board was composed; the render and check receipts were written after it.
